name: RTX Video — upscale and smooth on the NVIDIA card
description: Finishes a take with NVIDIA's RTX Video Super Resolution (×1–4, ULTRA by default) and, in smooth mode, RTX Frame Generation for twice the frame rate in real time; the soundtrack is kept. Seconds per clip, no model download: the effects ship in the nvidia-vfx wheel.

licence.name: NVIDIA Video Effects SDK (nvidia-vfx); nodes MIT (Comfy-Org)
obligations: The VFX runtime is NVIDIA-proprietary: review NVIDIA's SDK terms before redistributing an image that bundles it.

params.name: scale
params.label: Scale
params.description: 1.5 takes an LTX-refined 1152×2048 to 1728×3072, as in the MiniMax × LTXV workflow's samples.

params.name: quality
params.label: Model
params.description: ULTRA is trained on compressed video and cleans it; HIGHBITRATE_ULTRA preserves clean sources (try it on refined takes).

smooth.label: Upscale + 2× frame rate
smooth.description: RTX Frame Generation doubles the frames and the frame rate together, so the take keeps its length and lip-sync; then the upscale.

notes: Needs an NVIDIA RTX card (Turing or newer) and driver 570.190+/580.82+ on Linux. The node pack imports nvvfx, which needs the driver: on a CPU-only ComfyUI (the image build's validation) it does not load, so the recipe is validated against the schemas recorded in node-schemas.json.
